problem.statement: SIH26157: supervisors must assess many security operations centres periodically without re-examining every record by hand.

steps: CSE submits periodic evidence (alerts, cases, investigation steps, escalations, dispositions, assets)
SAT-SA validates and normalizes it with per-record provenance
deterministic detectors run (execution gap, negative space, anomaly, peer, coverage, workflow reconstruction)
findings are fused into entity risk and supervisory priority
each finding shows the source records it cites
a human supervisor records the decision
TRUST-SAT signs and verifies the recorded state
workflow_demonstrated.evidence: EXP-D01: 18/18 HTTP checks passed across a separate API process and worker process (SQLite, local storage)
workflow_demonstrated.status: demonstrated locally; not in containers, not on PostgreSQL or S3, not hosted

facts: FastAPI API and separate analysis worker with a durable queue
optional LangGraph orchestration with a human-review interrupt
tenant-aware persistence (PostgreSQL path implemented; SQLite measured)
ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signed supervisory receipts with a hash-chained ledger
architecture.status: implemented; PostgreSQL and S3 paths not live-verified

measured_evidence.claim: Validation matched its declared contract in 245/245 perturbed conditions
Robustness testing found and fixed a real product defect (a withheld workflow finding)
TRUST-SAT detected all 13 tested mutations of the recorded state
36/36 injected interruptions recovered with identical outputs
LangGraph added a median 0.096 s per workflow on one machine (interval includes zero)
Ranking beat random order in 20/20 generated populations
The unchanged pipeline ingested and analysed a real public IT incident log (50 groups, 22,604 incidents)

honest_limits_to_state: All SOC-shaped results are synthetic or controlled; no real SOC data was evaluated.
A simple closure-speed rule performed comparably to SAT-SA on generated populations.
On the real IT incident log, several detectors fired for every group and SAT-SA risk did not track SLA misses.
Stale and contradictory records are accepted without warning.
No human study or expert labels yet; protocol and label ingestion are ready.
Containers, live PostgreSQL, S3 and hosted deployment are not verified.
